dialogue_storage: PicLex 关键词标签 learning.example/exampleChinese 保存 canonical A,B,A,B 4 话轮对白（A=学习者朗读评分，B=机器朗读不评分，角色标记不朗读）；角色说明仅保留在 cards.roles 元数据；cards.targets 各词 example_en/example_zh 仍为定稿摘录。
communication_goal: 确认发布前的准备状态和放行条件。
image_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE standalone finished educational scene illustration, square 1024x1024. Pure white background, clean consistent black line art, minimalist adult stick figures with circular heads, simple expressive faces and thin limbs, restrained polished programmer workplace comic aesthetic. No color, no gradients, no shading, no photographic rendering. One coherent scene, no panels. Keep all people and props in the central area approximately x=180..820 and y=220..790 on a 0..1000 canvas. Preserve generous empty white space at top (y<180), bottom (y>850), and sides for learning labels added later. Make the named learning props clearly recognizable and fully visible. Gestures should show a conversation. No speech balloons, letters, numbers, captions, logos, watermarks, readable code, or long text; simple abstract UI marks are allowed. Scene: Two adult stick-figure developers sit at a table doing a pre-release check. A large unobstructed paper checklist lies in the center foreground, with square checkboxes, three check marks, and blank short horizontal lines; no letters or numbers. A clearly recognizable thin tablet with a simple screen and rounded rectangular bezel stands on a small support at the left part of the table, separate from the paper. One developer points toward the tablet, the other uses a pen beside the checklist. Keep tablet and checklist fully visible.

coverage_review.scope: W062 的逐词编辑与底图视觉核对完成；本专题其他计划卡未制作，不声称学习效果或手机端验收。

inversion.note: 原图保留；本卡发布用图为原图精确 RGB 反色（黑底白线）。

annotation_coordinate_system: [x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max]，左上角为原点，按最终 images/W062.png 宽高归一化至 0..1；由人工视觉定位。

image_review.summary: 通过：两名同事核对前景纸面检查清单与左侧平板，清单勾选和待确认项清楚。两件物件独立框选；备份就绪和发布准备由对白说明，不从勾选图案推断服务真实状态。
